rules.statement: Don't ask for a CHANGELOG bullet to be reworded or moved when its wording follows a set phrasing that the changelog's earlier entries use the same way, such as a stock opening sentence that applies only to its own bullet.
rules.why: The maintainer declined this kind of finding: the phrasing appears in many earlier bullets, also placed after user-facing bullets under the same heading, and rewording one entry would make it the only one that differs.
rules.check: Before reporting ambiguous or misleading wording in a changelog bullet, search the rest of CHANGELOG.md for the same phrase. If earlier releases use it the same way, at the start of a bullet and covering only that bullet, don't report it.
